_comment: Toy (2026-10-18): standard recurrent linear attention on 4x4 Sudoku to look for the associative-memory mechanism (cells write their hypotheses as v, recall peers' hypotheses with q). read = q~ (sum_t v k~^T)^T over this block's 16 cells only (no clock, EMA, STDP); the FFN is per cell, so every cross-cell inference must pass through the memory. Data data/sudoku4_toy.npz (split by solution grid, minimal puzzles, no augmentation so test grids stay unseen). hidden 12, 1 head, FFN inner 32, 4 blocks x 2 segments.
